defects.description: live_validation.py contains lines exceeding 140 characters and has formatting/structure limitations.
cli.py has potential readability concerns or modified sections that require better structuring.
test_live_validation.py is physically minified (only 44 lines) and does not cover the minimum required lines of 120 or complete live validation flows.
freshness_results.json hardcodes decision to FRESH_FROM_LIVE_PROVIDER instead of using evaluate_freshness output.
validation_summary.md hardcodes STATUS_SCHEDULED instead of using actual event status from normalized source.
provider_event_id is derived from scanner_event_id using string parsing (split('-', etc.) instead of maintaining an explicit mapping.
provider_scoreboard_snapshot.json stores a field named raw_payload_structure, which must be replaced with an explicit normalized_provider_event shape.
validation_manifest.json does not hash itself or explicitly document manifest self-hash handling or a validation_manifest.sha256 sidecar.
